full_judgment:
Syed Mahmud Hossain, J. This civil petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 04.02.2010 passed by the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 1938 of 2008 discharging the Rule and affirming judgment and order dated 18.03.2008 passed by the learned Additional District Judge, Kurigram in Other Class Appeal No. 24 of 2005 dismissing the appeal and affirming the judgment and decree dated 03.04.2005 passed by the learned Senior Assistant Judge, Roumari, Kurigram in Other Class Suit No. 16 of 2001 dismissing the suit. The facts, leading to the filing of this civil petition for leave to appeal, in brief, are: 

 4. The trial Court upon hearing the parties by its judgment and order dated 03.04.2005 dismissed the suit. Against that judgment and decree of the trial Court, the plaintiffs preferred Other Class Appeal No. 24 of 2005 before the learned District Judge, Kurigram. On transfer, the appeal was heard and disposed of by the then learned Additional District Judge, Kurigram, who by his judgment and order dated 18.03.2008 dismissed the appeal affirming the judgment and decree of the trial Court. 

 5. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the judgment and decree passed by the appellate Court, the plaintiffs preferred a revisional application before the High Court Division and obtained Rule in Civil Revision No. 1938 of 2008. The learned Single Judge of the High Court Division, by the judgment and order dated 04.02.2010 discharged the Rule affirming the judgments and decrees passed by the appellate Court as well as the trial Court.
